title: Compare sect contracts and complete a visible job application and interview

steps.description: Read the eight canonical employer salary projections
All eight configured employers are available to compare
Resolve the freelance employer by its canonical ID in the salary projection list
The freelance employer has no fixed salary multiplier and requires project contracts
Open the employer board from the normal home character card
Wait for the visible employer board
Scroll the normal employer list until the freelance contract control is inside the viewport
Confirm the freelance contract button is actually visible after scrolling
Verify the target employer application is in bounds and reachable

steps.name: sect-job-board
steps.description: Capture the salary comparison and current contract controls
Select the freelance employer from the rendered job board
Wait for the visible interview application confirmation
Submit the job application through the visible dialog button
Acknowledge any no-choice event result interrupt through its real visible button before continuing the interview
Acknowledge the resulting event summary through its real continue button
Wait until the event result modal has actually closed
Complete the interview with a visible risk-review answer
The low-experience application records its real interview result
A failed interview leaves the current contract unchanged

steps.name: sect-interview-rejected
steps.description: Capture the visible interview outcome and unchanged employer
